prompt: Record a decision: we keep unittest instead of pytest, because the library has no dependencies.
one_line: Record decisions in docs/decisions.md with a status; one home per fact.

checks.name: no new .md outside docs/
checks.cmd: test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | grep '^?? ' | grep '\.md$' | grep -v '^?? docs/')"

checklist: The decision entry states the decision, the reason (no dependencies) and a status (e.g. accepted).
